title: Page 133
transc:
Wash D. C. January 1863
E. J. Allen New York
Mr Watson says no record
of Capt Cortes Moher fifty
fourth New York Vols in
or out of service on
the files in Adjt. Gen's
office The information in regard
to vouchers of fifty second
NY Vols per your
dispatch yesterday cannot be obtained
today but may be tomorrow
WH Scott


2 PM
Washn D. C. Jany 2nd 1862
For Davies Columbus You must use
your best discretion about the number
of Youth to be retained at 
Columbus till you can communicate further
with Baiyor Columbus and its stores
must be well guarded signed Applause
